_comment: Owner-editable casting sheet for Zone 1 (k26_30). voice_id per speaker x locale is used by --audition; leave it null to skip that line. Values here are never generated automatically and never overwrite canonical dialogue.
casting_shortlist_source: Claude-analyzed from Owner-provided tools/e10_zone1_audio/_local_review/voices.json (27 ElevenLabs voices: 23 en, 4 zh). voice_id is pre-filled with Claude's top pick per role so no manual copying is required; see each role's candidates[] for the full 2-3 option shortlist and reasoning. No --audition has been run — that step waits for explicit Owner approval of this shortlist.

audio_config._comment: Governs which ElevenLabs model --audition (and future --generate-* modes) use. --check verifies this model_id exists and supports text-to-speech before any generation is attempted.

en.notes: Top pick: George. Change voice_id to another candidate's id below to override.

candidates.name: George - Warm, Captivating Storyteller
candidates.reason: Labeled narrative_story with the descriptor 'Warm, Captivating Storyteller' — the most literal match for an opening scene-setting narrator line ('the village wind already carries a hint of... something unusual').

candidates.name: Amelia - Enthusiastic and Expressive
candidates.reason: Also narrative_story category (professional tier); a brighter, more expressive alternative if the Owner wants a female narrator voice.

candidates.name: Sarah - Mature, Reassuring, Confident
candidates.reason: Mature/reassuring tone works for a narrator establishing mood before gameplay; entertainment_tv category suggests polished delivery.

candidates.reason: informative_educational + steady/calm/grounded reads as measured narration, closest zh match to the English top pick's tone.

candidates.name: Yui - Delicate, Graceful and Soothing
candidates.reason: Soothing, conversational delivery suits the quiet, atmospheric opening line before the cloud/threat is introduced.

candidates.name: Anna Su - Casual, Friendly and Bright
candidates.reason: Name literally matches the 'anna' speaker key; brighter/more casual tone if the Owner prefers a lighter narrator voice over a grave one.
